🎓 A Proud Milestone in My Academic Journey | B.A. LL.B. (Hons.)

I am delighted and deeply honoured to share that I have completed my B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) from Amity University, Patna, as a member of the 2019–2024 batch, graduating with Distinction.

I am especially grateful and humbled to have been awarded the Academic Silver Medal for my academic performance, securing the second-highest cumulative grade point in my batch.

This achievement is not just a recognition of academic excellence, but a reflection of the dedication, discipline, perseverance, and countless hours of hard work throughout these five transformative years.

I extend my heartfelt gratitude to my parents, family, professors, mentors, and Amity University for their unwavering support, guidance, and encouragement. This milestone would not have been possible without them.

As I close one chapter and step into the next, I carry with me immense gratitude, cherished memories, and a renewed commitment to learning and excellence.

Proud to be an Amity graduate. 💙⚖️🎓
